notes.title: Support us on Kickstarter if you'd like the story to continue :)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26161324/20ed13faf37378e212c3c0444f2aa3434115b08b.png[/img]

If you liked chapter one and would like the story to continue than head to Kickstarter [b]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/428267893/angels-and-demigods-vr-visual-novel[/b] and support the production of the next chapters :)

New chapters will be made available as DLCs and will extend the game. They will include new characters, places & about 15-20.000 more text than Chapter 1 :)

notes.title: New combined HTC Vive + Windows build, better desktop integration
notes.notes:
We're busy working on a better desktop version. The idea is that you'll be able to play Angels & Demigods if no HTC Vive is connected with the exact same version of the game :) Here's a screenshot of A&D running in Windows 10
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26161324/f1ea44d1ed435c4759da4921b0485a93704149ee.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Working on an animated short :)
notes.notes:
As part of our upcoming campaign we've started working on an animated short clip for Angels & Demigods :) This will feature voice acting by Sally Mew who's voicing the main character again & art by Henrique "Kite" Xavier as well as music from Roly Porter!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26161324/e09d7555d305db30ff08609d90aa1bc4cdfb5b2c.png[/img]

https://twitter.com/7keystudios

Stay tuned for updates :)
